# Sweep over-claim superlatives and stale MCP server claims in learn/benefits/body/

## Context

Parent epic `#20498` (*Example overviews and the learning section at the kitchen-sink standard*, Intended Solution §2), `@neo-fable-mnemosyne`'s 13-row `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393), Row 10 `over-claim-sweep`), and `neomjs/business#41` (`dated-items.json` row `benefit-pages` → Rows 1, 7, 10, 11):
- The 13 pages in `learn/benefits/body/` carry the highest concentration of the banned over-claim register in `learn/` (`"unparalleled"`, `"unprecedented"`, `"revolutionary"`, `"paradigm shift"`, `"the only platform truly ready for the AI era"`, `"the premiere target"`, `"the very first frontend platform"`, `"the first UI architecture"`, `"no other platform has truly accomplished"`), alongside stale MCP server topology claims in `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md` that predate the Two Hemispheres split (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain` + `neomjs/neo-agent-institution`).

## The Problem

Measured on `dev` (`ccb30d8d6e`) across `learn/benefits/body/*.md`:
1. **`learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md`:**
   - Line 10 claims unanchored `"40k+ ops/sec financial trading desks"`.
   - Lines 12, 14, 27, 34 use banned over-claim flavors (`.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §2): `"## The Paradigm Shift: Why the Industry Must Adapt"`, `"why Neo.mjs is the only platform truly ready for the AI era"`, `"the premiere target for AI generation"`, `"blazing-fast UI"`, `"The paradigm shift is that humans no longer need to write every line of code"`.
   - Line 45 states stale MCP topology (`"Coupled with a dedicated AI SDK and four frontier-harness MCP servers spanning Knowledge Base, Memory Core, Neural Link, and GitHub Workflow, plus a File System MCP server"`) instead of the Two Hemispheres architecture (the `60`-tool Neural Link joining the Engine to `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` and `neomjs/neo-agent-institution`).
2. **`learn/benefits/body/ObjectPermanence.md`:**
   - Line 20: `"## The Paradigm Shift: The Application Engine"`
   - Lines 73–78: `"## The Superpowers of True Persistence"`, `"unlocks architectural super-powers"`, and `"Neo.mjs is the first UI architecture built ground-up for autonomous AI collaboration."`
3. **`learn/benefits/body/FourEnvironments.md`:**
   - Line 5: `"Neo.mjs was the very first frontend platform, which enabled full support for a zero builds instant development mode"`
   - Line 50: `"offers unmatched speed and debugging clarity"`
   - Lines 60, 81: `"This unparalleled fidelity"`, `"### Unparalleled Debugging in Production"`
   - Lines 173–180: `"astronomically expensive"`, `"insane overhead"`, `"a novel approach that, to our knowledge, no other platform has truly accomplished"`
4. **`learn/benefits/body/Quick.md`:**
   - Lines 7, 35, 49: `"unparalleled debugging convenience"`, `"unprecedented control and insight"`, `"unprecedented speed and efficiency"`.
5. **`learn/benefits/body/Features.md`:**
   - Line 4: `"that deliver unparalleled performance"`
   - Line 17: `"its revolutionary Off-Main-Thread (OMT) paradigm"`.
6. **`learn/benefits/body/FormsEngine.md`:**
   - Lines 112, 117: `"### Nested Forms: Unprecedented Structural Flexibility"`, `"provides unparalleled structural flexibility"`.
7. **`learn/benefits/body/ConfigSystem.md`:**
   - Line 7: `"Modern JavaScript frameworks have revolutionized front-end development"`
   - Line 569: `"offers unparalleled control and flexibility"`.

## The Architectural Reality

- Per `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md`:
  - **§2 ("Exciting because truthful, never over-claiming"):** Bans the three over-claim flavors: (1) unprovable category-firsts (`"the first"`, `"the only"`, `"no other platform"`), (2) marketing superlatives (`"revolutionary"`, `"unparalleled"`, `"unprecedented"`, `"paradigm shift"`, `"unmatched"`, `"blazing-fast"`), and (3) unreceipted benchmark claims.
  - **§0 (Two Hemispheres):** `ApplicationEngine.md` sits at the Body boundary (`#14310` / `#14312`) and must name the live Neural Link (`60` runtime tools) and the Brain/Institution repositories (`neomjs/neo-agent-brain`, `neomjs/neo-agent-institution`) rather than the retired `"File System MCP server"` description.
  - **§5:** Never hand-edit `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

Design authority: `#20498` Intended Solution §2 + [`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393) Row 10 (`over-claim-sweep`) + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §§0–5.

## The Fix

Sweep the 7 affected files in `learn/benefits/body/` (`ApplicationEngine.md`, `ObjectPermanence.md`, `FourEnvironments.md`, `Quick.md`, `Features.md`, `FormsEngine.md`, `ConfigSystem.md`):
1. Replace every banned over-claim phrase with the concrete mechanism or verifiable property it was trying to describe (e.g., `1:1 module fidelity`, `direct runtime control`, `hierarchical form composition`, `Off-Main-Thread worker architecture`).
2. Update `learn/benefits/body/ApplicationEngine.md` line 10 and line 45 to cite measured capabilities (`100,000`-row buffered grids, multi-window workspaces) and the current Two Hemispheres / Neural Link (`60` tools) + `neo-agent-brain` / `neo-agent-institution` topology.
3. Preserve all Mermaid diagrams and runnable `live-preview` / `readonly` code blocks in `ObjectPermanence.md`, `FormsEngine.md`, and `ConfigSystem.md` intact.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/benefits/body/{ApplicationEngine,ObjectPermanence,FourEnvironments,Quick,Features,FormsEngine,ConfigSystem}.md` | `#20498` §2, Row 10 (`#issuecomment-6697670393`), `guide-authoring-bar.md` §§0–5 | Zero banned over-claim superlatives or unprovable category-firsts; accurate Two Hemispheres / Neural Link MCP description in `ApplicationEngine.md`; all diagrams and `live-preview` blocks preserved | Relative `.md` links pass `buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` | Self-documenting Markdown | `rg` zero-match receipt + `check-relative-links.mjs` pass |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0018 (`Two Hemispheres: Body + Brain joined by the Neural Link`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Zero Over-Claim Gate across `learn/benefits/body/`):** `rg -i "revolutionary|revolutioniz|first and only|very first frontend|first UI architecture|only platform|premiere target|paradigm shift|unparalleled|unprecedented|groundbreaking|lightning-fast|unmatched|no other platform|blazing-fast|super-power|superpower|insane|astronomically" learn/benefits/body/` returns `0` matches.
- [ ] **AC-2 (`ApplicationEngine.md` Two Hemispheres & MCP Accuracy):** Replaces the retired `"File System MCP server"` / `"four frontier-harness MCP servers"` text with the current Two Hemispheres topology (`Neural Link` 60-tool bridge + `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` Knowledge Base, Memory Core, and GitHub Workflow MCP servers + `neomjs/neo-agent-institution` Fleet Manager).
- [ ] **AC-3 (Link, Whitespace & Code-Fence Integrity):** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors, and all Mermaid diagrams and `live-preview` / `readonly` code blocks in `learn/benefits/body/` remain intact.
- [ ] **AC-4 (Generated Files Untouched):** `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and `apps/portal/llms.txt` are not modified (`guide-authoring-bar.md §5`).

## Out of Scope

Consolidating duplicate config-system guides (`ConfigSystem.md` vs `ConfigSystemDeepDive.md`, which belongs to Row 4 `guides-duplicate-questions` once its owner table is posted); rewriting `learn/comparisons/*` (Row 11 `comparisons-identity`); authoring the new enterprise evaluator shelf page (Row 7 `evaluator-shelf`).

## Avoided Traps

- Deleting or altering runnable ```javascript live-preview``` blocks in `FormsEngine.md` while editing headings.
- Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.
